sloka: तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गीं रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्।अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं क्रोधाद्रक्षोधिपात्मजम् ।। ६.८१.१८ ।।
transliteration: tāṁ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṁ rāmasya mahiṣīṁ priyām।abravīt paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ krodhādrakṣodhipātmajam ।। 6.81.18 ।।

translations.english: "O evil minded Indrajith! You are born as Rakshasa in the clan of seers of vedic mantras and sought the womb of Rakshasa woman. It is for your own self destruction you seized her hair.
